test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India, celebrated the International Women's Day week from ________ 2022 as an 'Iconic Week’ as a part of ‘Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 to 8 March**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government is celebrating 75 years of India’s Independence as** Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav **(AKAM), an initiative to honour **India’s glorious** history and unique diversity of language, culture, and people.
 
• It is being celebrated by the Ministry between **07th March 2022 to 13th March 2022**, to build a movement that activates **Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s** vision of **India 2.0**, an **Atmanirbhar Bharat**.
 
• To disseminate information about the important events of the Ministry under AKAM, the Ministry has** published a booklet on Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav** in the form of a weekly calendar.
 
• Celebrating e-Shram- Reaching milestone of 25 crore registration of unorganised workers, launch of **e-Shram on UMANG app**, launch of Donate-a-Pension, launch of e-book and award distribution** at Vigyan Bhawan**, New Delhi on 07th March.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Women’s Day celebration**: “Valuing, Empowering and Making Women workforce feel Special” through a unique week-long Social Security Service. (Ensuring 100% processing of Claims of Women on **8th March** in the country) at India Habitat Centre, New Delhi on 08th March 2022.
 
• 230th Meeting of the **Central Board of Trustees (CBT)** on **11th and 12th March 2022 at Guwahati**.
 
• Special programmes will be organised in the entire iconic week by **DTNBWED** on the contribution of **women in freedom struggle**, unorganised workers, women empowerment, road & fire safety, central trade union, etc at **27 places across India**.
 
• Job fairs, placement drives, and placement-oriented camps will be held in the entire iconic week with special focus on SC/STs and differently-abled by **DGE at 65 places across India**.
